scope: Isolated backend recovery from an existing saved-state checkpoint over a separately verified pinned reconstruction. This does not claim every live profile file stayed byte-identical.
limitations: The 325 saved checkpoint entries and 2504 separately verified reconstruction files are distinct inputs.
New four-module checkpoint coverage applies to future backups; the tested existing checkpoint was not rewritten.

One live headless profile timestamp advanced during its existing passive save. Follow-up observation after the isolated test ended reproduced only that timestamp change; the other 190 live profile files stayed byte-identical.
This backend rehearsal does not prove a physical host recovery, a new headless raid or Windows first-install behavior.
Encrypted recovery preparation was checked locally; the earlier manual Drive copy was not replaced.

The rehearsal-start live headless JSON body was not retained, only its hash. The exact timestamp-only field comparison applies to the separate follow-up snapshots, not the entire original rehearsal window.
